pages.raw_meta:
Smart Sand Industrial Product Solutions
At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures
raw_blocks: At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures we meet all your sand needs.
Diverse Product Selection: From coarse to fine grains, we have it all.
Extensive Shipping Network: With access to 6 railroads, we deliver across the USA, Canada, and Mexico.
Flexible Loading and Shipping Options: We offer loading and shipping via “Bulk bag, 3000#”, high-speed truck loading for both pneumatic and bottom dump, and bulk shipping via rail.
Custom Solutions: Offering custom blending and in-house packaging to suit your specific requirements.

SmartSand is dedicated to the industrial market, ensuring a consistent, long-term supply of high-quality sand at competitive prices. Our industrial team, boasting over 100 years of combined experience, is committed to providing exceptional products to markets worldwide. Utilizing in-house state of the art technology for gradation, ADV, pH, LOI, Moisture, and XRF (Powder/Pellet).

Our rapid expansion is a testament to our strategic commitment and the trust our customers place in us. Partnering with SmartSand means discovering a new way of doing business, one that sets you apart from the competition.
Let SmartSand streamline your operations. Contact us today to discuss how we can support your business at IPSSales@smartsand.com and let’s discuss how we can support your business.
